requirements.title: repository-manager hosts the Git development-governance modules

evidence.description: Implementation commit is published on a branch; not yet merged to the default branch.

requirements.title: Single authority for Git development governance
Branch allocation tracks ownership, lease, and lifecycle state
Isolated checkouts never corrupt shared Git config
Commits stage only reviewed paths and verified gate identity
Merge-queue promotion rechecks identity before reporting success
Cleanup proves containment before deleting a branch checkout
Concept reservations are scoped and cannot be silently reused
readme-deploy-block hook must not silently skip
Cleanup removes isolated checkouts and scratch only after merge
requirements.remaining: Containment-before-delete for worktree/branch is implemented and tested, but no host-local build-scratch removal, uv-cache-prune step, or distinct 'cleanup run log' artifact was found in repository-manager's own code.

requirements.title: Workspace check refuses credential-embedded remote URLs
Complexity gate scores exhaustive-dispatch functions correctly
Clone-duplication gate enforces zero new pairs before push
Routine cleanup prunes merged branches and build caches
requirements.remaining: Reachability/merge-containment checks before cleanup are implemented and tested; no uv-cache-prune step was found as part of the same routine, and no 'cleanup checklist' document exists in this repository.

requirements.title: KISS hook resolves test module path declarations correctly
Duplication gate fails closed on an empty-change commit
Reviewed-distinct clone pairs are tracked in a registry
Status page stays in sync with capability and reservation docs
Build verification on extracted trees uses content hashes
A fast rebase must not silently skip the hook suite
Completion claims require full hook-run logs as proof
Continuous review-and-merge replaces batch integration
Cleanup removes leftover backup references and build scratch
Build submission is asynchronous, not polling-based
Dependency-readiness hook works from any checkout location

requirements.title: A fix is accepted only when all quality gates pass together
Duplication gate distinguishes real new duplication from moves
Secret-history exceptions are digest-pinned and self-checking
The repository passes its own full local gate suite
